matches.classification: Ordinary noun within a specialist context; expression, authority and domain gates remain unaccepted.

uses.text: The dermatologist, radiologist and pathologist discussed the available findings within their respective roles.
uses.context: Coordinating a fictional assessment review.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun within a specialist context; expression, authority and domain gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Respective clinical roles are professional functions, with separate interpretation and diagnostic-review gates.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun within a specialist context; expression, authority and domain gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Accountant and auditor roles are work functions; their actual professional duties and financial conclusions are not accepted.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun within a specialist context; expression, authority and domain gates remain unaccepted.

other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fifth-ten match. Preserve employer/employee/contractor inclusion without inferring employment status or authority.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: To write one's name on a document as a form of identification or agreement.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Please sign the attendance sheet.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Sign is the act of writing a name; signature selects the resulting written-name mark. Preserve the attendance example without changing the held attendance entry.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The address used for billing or payment records.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Please check the billing address on the order.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Billing address is a complete postal-record term whose purpose differs from delivery; the selected address component does not verify a payment record.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A reference code associated with authorization of a payment transaction.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The approval code appears in the transaction record.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An approval code is a transaction reference, not permission itself or proof that a payment is valid.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Permission or a reference issued for a particular return process.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The service team will confirm the return authorization.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Return authorization may denote permission or its reference; preserve both possibilities without treating the record as generic consent.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A person's agreement to a particular action or use of information.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The colleague asked whether the customer had given consent for marketing messages.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A person's agreement is not interchangeable with authority-given permission or proof that privacy consent is valid.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The extent of access or actions allowed for an account.
related_entry_boundaries.example: This permission level does not allow price changes.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An account permission level is access scope, not the uncountable act of allowing a person to act.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A named or unnamed callable unit of code that performs an operation.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The function checks the supplied value.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A callable software function is not a person's organizational role; the shared word function does not join the senses.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The process of determining which actions or resources an identity may access.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Authorization determines whether the account can edit this record.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Authorization is a decision process about actions/resources, distinct from permission as allowance and from authentication.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An access-control model in which permissions are associated with roles assigned to identities.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The system uses role-based access control for editing records.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Access-control roles are categories in a permission model; they need not be identical to work roles and confer no reviewed policy guarantee.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An Internet Protocol address used to identify an interface for communication on an IP network.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The local test service displays its IP address.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An IP address identifies a network interface; it is not a street or postal address.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A sequence describing the location of a file or directory within a filesystem.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The file path is relative to the project directory.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A file path describes a logical filesystem location, outside the selected physical-place location and postal-address senses.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: To place a person or body part in a particular position according to the relevant care plan.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The nurse explained who would help position the patient.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Position here is a body-placement verb, not the location noun or a job role; the care plan remains a separate gate.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A finding that can be observed or measured during assessment.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The nurse recorded the observed sign.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A clinical sign is an observable finding, distinct from signing a name or a written signature.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A person's voluntary agreement to a proposed intervention after relevant information and an opportunity for understanding, subject to applicable requirements.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The clinician checked that the informed consent discussion was documented.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Informed care consent has decision-specific information and voluntariness requirements; ordinary permission does not establish them.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A form documenting aspects of an agreement process; the form alone does not establish valid consent.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The clinician explained how the consent form relates to the discussion.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A consent form is documentation; neither the form nor a signature alone proves valid consent.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A recorded date and time associated with an event or entry.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The timestamp identifies when the note was entered.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A timestamp records event time, whereas a time zone is a regional convention; recorded time may need date/zone context.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Electronic information used to indicate signing or approval under the relevant system and legal arrangements.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The team clarified what the electronic signature confirms.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Electronic signing information may not be a handwritten name. System and legal effect remain separate from the signature lexeme.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A responsibility to take appropriate care regarding another person's welfare, with its exact scope depending on the role and law.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The trainer asked a qualified adviser to explain the local duty of care.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Duty of care is a role/law-dependent obligation, not a generic work task or inferred permission to provide care.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A list used to check the status of agreed tasks.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The worker marked only completed tasks on the task checklist.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A task checklist records item status; it is neither a task itself nor evidence that unchecked work was completed.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The address to which goods are to be sent.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The customer asked to check the shipping address through the approved process.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Shipping address selects a delivery destination within the postal sense, but neither its accuracy nor approved-use scope is accepted.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The relative urgency or importance assigned to a support case under a policy.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The supervisor reviewed the ticket priority against the criteria.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Ticket priority is a policy-governed degree of urgency/importance, not a countable important item or automatic emergency triage.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A device that shows the time.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The clock in the meeting room is five minutes slow.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A clock displays time and can be inaccurate; a time zone is neither that device nor its reading.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An address used to return a postal item if it cannot be delivered.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The return address is printed on the envelope.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Return address is the designated postal return destination; it is distinct from the recipient or billing address.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization for specified work-related travel under the relevant arrangements.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The travel approval covers this journey only.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Travel approval is bounded authorization for a specified journey; a lexical permission review does not grant it.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization to make a particular payment under the relevant rules.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The invoice is waiting for payment approval.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Payment approval is a particular authorization under rules, separate from a signature, identity or payment success.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization to make a specified purchase within the relevant scope or limits.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Purchase approval does not confirm that the item has arrived.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Purchase approval authorizes a defined purchase within limits; it does not establish delivery or acceptance of goods.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The stock position identified for selecting an item in a picking task.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The pick location on the task differs from the bin label.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Pick location is a stock-selection position; the record can disagree with a label and does not prove actual stock position.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An identified storage position within a warehouse, such as a shelf space or compartment.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The bin location differs from the one shown in the item record.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Bin location is a warehouse position or compartment, compatible with physical place but separately identified and reviewed.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A code used to identify a storage or work position in a facility.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The location code is missing from the movement record.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A location code identifies a place; the code is not the physical place itself.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An assigned piece of work to restore stock at a specified location or supply point.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The replenishment task refers to the wrong destination location.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A replenishment task is a specific stock-restoration work item; quantities, destination and safe method remain separate.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Permission granted through the relevant process for a person to carry out a specified equipment activity.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Confirm the equipment authorization with the responsible supervisor.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Equipment authorization permits a specified activity through a process; it neither proves competence nor replaces safety review.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A scan used to capture or confirm a storage-location identifier.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The task needs the correct location scan before the record can be reviewed.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A location scan captures an identifier, not the location itself or proof that the captured record is correct.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A manager responsible for relevant operations during an assigned period of duty.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The duty manager will confirm the appropriate review contact.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Duty manager names a person with assigned-period responsibilities, not a duty or grant of universal authority.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A form used to collect a guest's comments about their experience for a stated purpose.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Offer the guest feedback form in an accessible format.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A guest feedback form collects comments; it is the instrument rather than the response information.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Comments or information about someone's experience of a delivery.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The team is reviewing the customer's delivery feedback.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Delivery feedback is a domain-specific form of evaluative information, without certifying delivery quality or a response process.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A configurable rule specifying an allowed action for an account or group.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The permission setting is awaiting the access owner's review.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A permission setting is a configurable access rule, separate from ordinary allowance and valid consent.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The sequence of steps through which a request is reviewed and authorized.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The approval workflow identifies the responsible reviewer.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An approval workflow is a sequence of review steps, not an approval decision or permission itself.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A record of the relevant agreement, scope, and applicable consent arrangements, not proof by itself that consent is valid.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The consent record describes the agreed support session scope.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A consent record documents arrangements but is not by itself valid consent or sufficient authorization.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Agreement to specified remote access under applicable consent and authorization arrangements.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The remote access consent covers the agreed support activity only.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Remote-access consent concerns an agreed activity and relevant requirements; it is distinct from technical access permission.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A tool that shows running tasks and resource use, sometimes providing management actions.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The task manager view shows the application's resource use.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Task manager is a computing utility for running processes/resources; it is not a manager of ordinary human work items.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization for a defined change under stated conditions.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The change approval covers this version and maintenance window.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Change approval is constrained to a defined change and conditions, not generic permission for later versions.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A questionnaire used to collect comments or ratings about an experience.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The feedback survey asks about the user's support experience.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A feedback survey is a questionnaire that elicits evaluative information; it is not the information or an accepted measure of satisfaction.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Feedback from a fellow learner or colleague.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The group agreed how to offer respectful peer feedback.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Peer feedback identifies the contributor as a fellow learner or colleague; it remains distinct from self-assessment or authority approval.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The relevant consent arrangements for taking, storing, or using a person's images for stated purposes.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The team checked the scope of photo consent before the planned use.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Photo consent has purpose/use scope and separate privacy requirements; a permission slip does not substitute for it.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A form used to request or record permission for a specified activity.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The permission slip identifies the planned activity.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A permission slip requests or records allowance. It is a document and does not itself prove valid consent.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization of an internal request for a job position.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The requisition approval is still pending.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Requisition approval concerns an internal position request; it is neither hiring permission in every case nor acceptance of a candidate.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Information given to a candidate about their application or assessment.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The recruiter explained when candidate feedback would be available.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Candidate feedback is response information about application/assessment, without certifying employment criteria or decisions.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization to use a specified resource or information.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The manager requested a review of the access permission.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Access permission is resource-specific authorization, distinct from identity authentication and organizational-role labels.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The sequence of roles through which an approval request passes.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The request follows the stated approval chain.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An approval chain sequences required decision roles; the chain alone is not permission or a completed approval.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A table showing how responsibilities for activities are assigned to roles.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The responsibility matrix identifies who will provide the update.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A responsibility matrix maps work duties to roles; it is a table and does not establish that its allocations are valid.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Acceptance of a material for a defined project use through the applicable review process.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The material approval covers only the stated product and application.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Material approval is limited acceptance for a defined product/application, not broad permission or a generic priority decision.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Acceptance of a submitted sample under defined criteria and scope.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The sample approval records the agreed finish reference.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Sample approval has particular criteria and scope; it does not certify every later supplied material.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A record of what use or action was permitted and its relevant scope.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The permission record identifies the approved image use.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A permission record describes allowance and scope, not the allowance act itself or proof of current valid consent.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The current state of a required approval.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The approval status is still pending.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Approval status is the current recorded state, not an authorization decision or guarantee of completion.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization of content for a stated use.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Content approval is required before this page is published.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Content approval covers a stated use and actual process; ordinary permission does not supply publishing authority.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A planned cycle of comments and response on work.
related_entry_boundaries.example: This feedback round covers the layout and wording.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A feedback round is a planned cycle of response, not the comments themselves or approval of the work.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The ending of a previously given agreement to an action or purpose, subject to the applicable context and requirements.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The record documents the withdrawal of consent and the subsequent discussion.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Withdrawal of consent concerns ending an agreement with context-specific effects, not simply revoking a software permission.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A stamp that reproduces a person's signature.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Use of the signature stamp requires the applicable authorization.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A signature stamp reproduces a mark; it is a device whose authorized use and legal effect remain unaccepted.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A boundary on a person's authority to approve an amount or action.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The request exceeds this approver's stated approval limit.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An approval limit bounds authority by amount or action, rather than being the permission itself.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A table showing which roles may authorize particular actions under stated conditions.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The authorization matrix identifies the required role for this request.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An authorization matrix records which roles may authorize under conditions; organizational role language does not validate the matrix.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An address designated for service of legal documents under the applicable arrangements.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The reviewer will confirm the service address in the record.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A service address is designated under legal-service arrangements; its formal validity cannot be inferred from ordinary postal meaning.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A court order reflecting the parties' agreement as approved by the court under the applicable process.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The consent order must be distinguished from the parties' earlier draft agreement.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A consent order is a court order under a process, distinct from parties' agreement, generic permission or a signature alone.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Authorization required to bring an appeal in a process that imposes that requirement.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The lawyer will check whether permission to appeal is required.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Permission to appeal is process-specific authorization requiring legal review; the ordinary noun does not determine whether it is needed.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The transfer of specified legal rights to another party under applicable law.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The proposed assignment requires review of the rights involved.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Assignment here transfers legal rights, not an assigned duty or work task.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An obligation arising from a professional role and its applicable rules.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The lawyer will explain the relevant professional duty.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Professional duty depends on role and applicable rules; it is not merely any assigned task and does not establish competence.
